name: Singapore
about: Hot and humid year-round with no real weather off-season; Feb–Apr is driest, Nov–Jan brings the heaviest monsoon rain.
overview: A hyper-efficient garden city where hawker-center food, world-class dining, and some of Asia's most ambitious architecture all sit a short MRT ride apart.
costOverview: Hawker food and transit stay cheap; alcohol and Western-style dining are where costs jump.
